reviewed_document: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
summary: 事务与隔离主方向正确，但既有 Registry audit 字段合同冲突，现有 created-only verifier 到 active 生命周期的统一分派尚未冻结；不建议进入编码。

findings.title: Audit result conflicts with tools.Registry.Call
findings.recommendation: Registry success emits Result=ok; keep queued in receipt/outbox or define explicit versioned mapping. Do not claim Registry-native audit says queued.

findings.title: Missing complete lifecycle verifier dispatch
findings.recommendation: Enumerate pilot facade entrypoints and route created versus active to one strict verifier; created-only verifier currently rejects any later receipts/outbox.

findings.title: Audit Args and Registry auditor mapping are inconsistent
findings.recommendation: Capture original AuditEntry using a Registry constructed with task-local buffer. Keep Args={bytes:N}; validate schema/scope/effect order separately, unless a versioned mapping is explicitly specified.

findings.title: Isolated effect handler assembly not specified
findings.recommendation: Specify no-Room test App/task/frozen teacherEffects context and Registry-local buffered auditor; call only say and show_word index 0. Avoid global Registry/auditor.

findings.title: DDL is compatible but verifier migration remains underspecified
findings.recommendation: State v2 DDL remains unchanged and active rows are handled by strict active codec/verifier; if schema columns change, require new schema version.

findings.title: Receipt order, unknown commit, active lifecycle constraints
findings.recommendation: Authorization then receipt lookup before CAS and conservative pending_unknown semantics align with existing keys/checks.

findings.title: Freeze outbox effect kind and payload schema
findings.recommendation: Distinguish tool input {index:0} from show_word handler result/action payload; specify exact kind and payload contract.

findings.title: Test harness build boundary
findings.recommendation: Apply pilot_e2e build tag to all files in harness package; verify default package graph excludes it.

findings.title: Fault-injection proof conditions
findings.recommendation: Prove rollback before pre-COMMIT no-record assertions; post-COMMIT E2E hook must independently verify all rows before dropping response.

findings.title: State codec matches current State fields and DDL capacity
findings.recommendation: Exact State fields and zero initialization align; existing v2 DDL supports active checkpoint and ordered two-effect outbox without schema changes.
